title: Braised Beef Stew
description: A hearty stew made with tender beef, vegetables, and a rich, flavorful sauce.
instructions: Heat oil over medium-high heat in a large Dutch oven.
Brown the beef on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot.
Add the onion and carrot to the pot, cooking until they begin to soften.
Add the flour and stir to combine, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously.
Return the browned beef to the pot, along with any accumulated juices.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2-3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Add the potatoes and red wine (if using), and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the beef dripings and Russian seasoning.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley (if desired).
